format: Studio/Custom partnership formats and the 'Other / Studio-defined' style
requirement: Studio/Custom partnership formats (couples, Pro-Am, Pro-Pro, professional couples, Jack & Jill, solo) and the Other / Studio-defined style carry no NDCA, UCWDC or WSDC compliance claim; their text is a neutral description of the DanceFlow format and says nothing about what a body defines. Studio age labels (Youth, Adult, Senior) carry no thresholds and map to no body class.
enforcement_point: TypeScript display layer in the setup wizard page and deriveDraft. Gaps: names saved for new setups come from the immutable SQL profile; registration, results and staff pages show saved names only and do not identify the rules profile.
